status: frozen before fitting or observing transformed scores
purpose: Reduce binary quantization loss and investigate a 256-bit accuracy/cost tradeoff
feature_source: Frozen FaceNet VGGFace2 embeddings already used in R1
training_selection: revision_v2/data/lfw_extended_selection.json subjects[4992:] and matching embedding rows; 4992=512 calibration+512 unknown+3968 maximum-gallery distractors
training_observations: One previously selected embedding per identity, all remaining identities used without recognition-based selection
exclusions: All 192 original LFW identities, all 512 calibration identities, all 512 unknown test identities, and every distractor used in galleries up to 4096
normalization: Normalize source embeddings before fitting; enrollment averages the same frozen two images and normalizes the prototype; transform gallery/probe/calibration/test with the same training-only mean and projection

ITQ.projection: PCA eigenvectors of centered training covariance, descending eigenvalue order
ITQ.rotation: random orthogonal initialization, alternate sign codes and orthogonal Procrustes updates

float_controls: PCA-projected cosine for each code width
metrics: paired rank1 and rank5 over all 20 existing image assignments and all frozen gallery sizes
calibration-only thresholds and observed unknown-test FPIR/DIR
candidate recall, certified fallback, and public capacity sufficiency on frozen split0, block widths4/8
code length and estimated MPC mask/score work, distinguished from measured MPC timings
reporting: Keep every predefined method. Treat this as a development extension because original benchmark outcomes have already been inspected. A selected variant needs frozen subsequent confirmation; do not label repeated images as independent identities.
attribution: ITQ is an established preprocessing method, not our novelty; separate its effect from protected-template score preservation.
scheduling: No training or heavy scoring during MPC timing measurements
